limitations.message:
Coverage limit: Complete protocol page text is retained. Footnotes, color palettes, hardware-only rows and channel-allocation explanations remain authoritative raw context; no hardware validation. Table extraction preserves merged-cell context; combined modifier cells are retained literally and do not imply every modifier simultaneously.
Not included: A chart row with uncertain addresses or conditions; see the cited source.

Based on archived manufacturer documentation. The complete extraction metadata, original excluded chart rows and source files are retained in the manufacturer evidence archive. No hardware testing is claimed.
